items.quote: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified.
items.claim: Moses tells Aaron that this is what the LORD said: He will be sanctified in those who come near Him, and glorified before all the people.
items.mechanism: quoting a statement he attributes to the LORD

items.claim: Aaron said nothing in reply to Moses.
